Mechanical Engineering and Engineering Science
Graduate Programs
Graduate Programs
Advance your expertise and expand your impact with graduate study in Mechanical Engineering and Engineering Science at UNC Charlotte. The department offers a nationally recognized Master of Science program, a Ph.D. program and a specialized graduate certificate, providing flexible pathways to deepen your knowledge and accelerate your career.
As a graduate student, you’ll work alongside faculty on cutting-edge research in areas such as bioengineering, advanced manufacturing, motorsports engineering, energy systems and computational mechanics, gaining the skills to solve complex, real-world challenges. Whether you’re preparing for leadership in industry or pursuing advanced research and innovation, this program equips you to take the next step in engineering.

Graduate Assistantships
Gain hands-on experience while supporting your graduate education. Assistantships offer opportunities to work with faculty on teaching and research projects while providing tuition support and professional development in your field.

Tuition Support
Graduate students at UNC Charlotte can access tuition support through assistantships and Graduate School funding programs. These opportunities help reduce the cost of study while providing hands-on experience in teaching and research, making graduate education more affordable and impactful.

Jorian Khan
“I was looking for Mechanical Engineering Ph.D. programs with emphasis on metrology. UNC Charlotte is the place to study metrology in the U.S. In reality, I committed to UNC Charlotte after meeting with the faculty and other students. The students and faculty have been wonderfully welcoming and extremely generous sharing their knowledge. I came for the metrology but I stayed because of the welcoming environment and the wonderful people.”
